lead.title: NVIDIA ships Kumo Tabular, an open-weights tabular-prediction model that needs no training pass
lead.summary: NVIDIA released Kumo Tabular, an open-weights foundation model for tabular prediction that labels new tables in a single forward pass with no training or feature engineering step. It comes in three sizes (28M-215M parameters), was pretrained only on synthetic data, ranks first on TabArena, BeyondArena, TALENT and ScoringBench, and ships under the OpenMDW-1.1 license for commercial use, with code and weights on GitHub and Hugging Face.

top_stories.title: Holo4 computer-use weights land: Holo4-27B (dense) and Holo4-35B-A3B (MoE) for local agent stacks
top_stories.summary: H Company published the Holo4 family of generalist computer-use VLMs: Holo4-27B (dense, built on Qwen3.8-27B, CC BY-NC 4.0) and Holo4-35B-A3B (MoE with 3B active params, Apache 2.0, self-hostable for commercial use). One checkpoint can click a GUI, type, run code, call MCP servers and hit APIs, with 256K context, GGUF/FP8/NVFP4 builds, 85.2% on OSWorld at $0.08/task, and documented vLLM and llama.cpp serving.

top_stories.title: Home Assistant Core 2026.10 reworks the LLM tool API: ToolResult and tool annotations
top_stories.summary: LLM tools now return an llm.ToolResult with an error flag, and tools declare a title, an owning integration, and read_only/destructive/idempotent/open_world annotations served to MCP clients. A security-relevant rework for anyone wiring local LLMs or MCP servers into Home Assistant.

top_stories.title: SSD streaming runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 177B (119 GiB NVFP4) at 9-10 tok/s on one 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti
top_stories.summary: A home-built inference engine for MoE models that don't fit in VRAM+RAM keeps most weights on SSD and pages experts in per token, hitting 9-10 tok/s decode on a single consumer GPU with 32 GB RAM (14-15 tok/s expected in v2). A durable workaround pattern for running 100 GB+ MoE checkpoints on a budget box instead of multi-GPU rigs.

top_stories.title: Nvidia and AMD GPUs are up to 40% more expensive over three months, with another Q4 hike expected
top_stories.summary: Price-tracking data shows average Nvidia GPU prices rose 41.3% and AMD Radeon prices 28.3% between June and September, with RTX 5090 AIB models crossing $7,000 on Amazon by Sept 29 and Nvidia reportedly raising GDDR6/GDDR7 prices to board partners again. A further AMD-wide price hike is expected in Q4.

items.title: STEPQuant: when and where errors matter in delta-rule recurrent-state quantization
items.summary: Shows that quantizing the fixed-size recurrent state of delta-rule linear-attention models to low precision causes severe accuracy degradation via error propagation, and proposes state-specific quantization that preserves accuracy under a reduced memory footprint for concurrent serving.

items.title: LeapQuant: efficient linear attention with accurate recurrent-state quantization
items.summary: Targets hybrid LLMs with linear attention (Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention) and quantizes the fixed-size recurrent state accurately, compressing long context and cutting inference memory while limiting accuracy loss.

items.title: MetaCtrl: a metacognitive controller for shorter, cheaper reasoning
items.summary: Adds a metacognitive controller that regulates reasoning-token allocation in large reasoning models, cutting redundant chain-of-thought on simple problems while preserving accuracy — reducing per-query token cost at inference.

items.title: AdviSD: a small advisor model steering a frozen LLM via multi-turn self-distillation
items.summary: Trains a small advisor model to steer a frozen LLM executor with natural-language advice in multi-turn interactions — a small-model-plus-frozen-model composition pattern relevant to low-cost inference stacks.

items.title: ProvenanceGuard: source-aware factuality verification for MCP agents
items.summary: Multiverse Computing's verifier for MCP-based agents detects cross-source conflation — where a claim is supported somewhere in the pooled evidence but not by the source the answer actually cites — targeting tool-using agents that pull from search tools, databases and MCP records.

items.title: AgentBull/bongard-mini: an open-weight T5-based 'System One' model for machine intuition
items.summary: A newly published open-weight System One model for machine intuition and Jev-like judgment, built on the T5 encoder-decoder. It joins a fast-filling field of open replications of the closed Jev decision API (Laya, Kev-9B, openjev).

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization trends: a 99.2M speaker-diarization/VAD model
items.summary: NVIDIA's compact diarization/VAD model joined the top of the Hugging Face trending chart alongside its Nemotron 3 family listings on OpenRouter.

items.title: TetiAI's Titan 5 and Titan 5 Flash: European frontier models that keep data in Europe
items.summary: Italian startup TetiAI announced frontier models built on open foundations with data processed and stored in European data centers under GDPR/AI Act rules. Titan 5 is priced at $1.00/M input tokens, roughly a tenth of the cost of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1.

items.title: llama.cpp keeps its near-daily build cadence with b11277
items.summary: Build b11277 landed on September 30, continuing the rapid build line (b11243 on Sept 29, b11269 in the same window) with no breaking-change notes in the nightly series.

items.title: Reflex Engine claims a cold-start TTFT win over llama.cpp and vLLM
items.summary: Show HN debut of Reflex, a local LLM inference engine whose authors benchmark it beating llama.cpp and vLLM on cold-start time-to-first-token. Early proof-of-concept stage, but relevant to local inference runtime watchers.

items.title: Moching: a Rust desktop agent with 219 built-in tools
items.summary: Show HN launch of an AI desktop agent written in Rust that ships with 219 built-in tools, positioning itself as a local-first alternative to hosted agent platforms.

items.title: Runtape: counterfactual replay and regression tests for AI agent runs
items.summary: Records AI agent runs and replays them counterfactually to build regression tests, targeting agent workflow reliability.

items.title: Foreman: a Director agent that routes work to worker agents
items.summary: An agent orchestration system that routes work from a Director agent to worker agents, aimed at self-hosted multi-agent workflows.

items.title: Postgres MCP server keeps an agent-editable context file
items.summary: A Postgres MCP server that maintains a context file the agent can append to, letting coding agents accumulate schema knowledge across sessions.

items.title: Guide: Qwen 3.8 27B Q4 with 100K context on a 16 GB RX 7800 XT via llama.cpp
items.summary: An actively discussed r/LocalLLaMA guide running Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_XS at ~30 tok/s decode with 100K context on a 16 GB RX 7800 XT using llama-server flags (--fit on, --jinja, --reasoning-format deepseek, tuned sampling) — a practical AMD/Vulkan recipe for mid-range VRAM cards.

items.title: n8n 2.42.0: AI Agent tool nesting, API workflow metadata, self-host fixes
items.summary: The AI Agent Tool can now use its own tools under pre-v3 parent agents, workflow descriptions are accepted on creation via API, and Azure OpenAI authentication, Redis reconnection and memory-management issues affecting self-hosted deployments are fixed.

items.title: RTX 5070 Ti: GDDR7 overclocked from 28 to 39 Gbps, lifting bandwidth from 896 to 1,248 GB/s
items.summary: An overclocker (via the mVolt+ Extreme tool) pushed Samsung GDDR7 on a GIGABYTE RTX 5070 Ti from stock 28 Gbps to 39 Gbps, a ~39-40% memory overclock. Game gains were minimal (~5 FPS), but it shows how much headroom Blackwell's memory subsystem has beyond its soldered configuration.

items.title: AMD Adrenalin 26.9.2 WHQL updates the Ryzen AI NPU MCDM driver stack
items.summary: The optional driver (Sept 29) adds optimizations for six games and fixes intermittent driver timeouts on Radeon GPUs, and ships an updated Ryzen AI NPU MCDM component relevant to on-device AI inference on AI PCs.
